parsed.explanation: Documented traveller-facing positives: no trans-specific criminal offence, no facility exclusion, foreign documents and X markers accepted, goods-and-services anti-discrimination protection in every state since 2017, a hate-speech ban, and a police duty to avoid bias-motivated action. Social acceptance is documented (65% support for same-sex marriage, openly trans service members). Negatives: a neo-Nazi dating-app ambush network, though its documented victims are gay and bisexual men and trans exposure is unresolved; a far-right electoral rise; and an unbroken hate-crime total with no trans breakdown, so trans-specific violence is undocumented rather than assessed. Detention placement rules are an open question, not an established exposure. Resident-facing gaps (psychiatric opinion requirement, no expungement) are climate signals only. Net: reduced-to-low risk, held below the top band by the unresolved violence and detention questions.
